name: pi-jarvis
description: A Pi side-conversation overlay with shared persistent memory and an optional searchable full-session archive.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: npm run check && node --import tsx --test test/jarvis.test.ts test/config-regression.test.ts test/index-regression.test.ts test/main-context-regression.test.ts test/overlay-regression.test.ts test/side-runtime.test.ts test/editor-polish.test.ts test/layout-polish.test.ts test/scroll-polish.test.ts test/status-polish.test.ts test/ux-polish.test.ts test/native-mcp.test.ts test/release-automation.test.ts test/branding.test.ts test/memory-config.test.ts test/memory-content.test.ts test/memory-store.test.ts test/memory-integration.test.ts test/archive-config.test.ts test/archive-store.test.ts test/archive-extension.test.ts test/archive-integration.test.ts
